text: We have contractual agreements with our AI subprocessors that prohibit the use of customer data to train their models.
Slack does not train generative AI models on Customer Data.
Approving a purchase requires biometric verification, such as Face ID or Touch ID, on a supported device.
Temporary chats don’t show in history, don’t use/create memories, and aren’t used to train models.

My AI only has access to your general location if you share it with Snapchat or chat about it with My AI.
Snapchat needs access to your contacts to match a phone number to a Snapchat account.
If a ChatGPT user asks you to be their trusted contact, OpenAI may receive your name, email address, and/or phone number from that user.
Deleted chats are permanently removed from OpenAI systems within 30 days
